status: implemented ownership map after Concept 7J extraction

globalStoreDecision.reason: Existing Project/Run/Artifact repositories and feature hooks already own durable state. App-level composition can keep transient cross-feature state explicit without a demonstrated correctness problem requiring a new state library.

state: active Project/Scenario and workspace lineage selectors
current working plan inputs and Inventory used by multiple tools
top-level tool/drawer navigation and cross-panel selection/focus, including selectedArtifactId
map presentation state that also enters Project snapshots
analysis outputs, rendered layers and cross-feature result/freshness inputs
owners.source: React source state plus useProjectWorkspace, API bootstrap and result-producing workflows
owners.mutationApi: App transaction handlers and existing domain/repository hooks; feature components receive explicit actions
owners.lifecycle: App lifetime; workspace values hydrate from the selected Project/Scenario; RF edits invalidate rendered result data but retain the current Run identity for stale lineage; Scenario/Project transitions clear current association where required
owners.rationale: These values cross Inventory, RF execution, map, result lineage and navigation. Moving them only to reduce App size would hide ownership.

owners.mutationApi: saveDraft, saveScenario, saveScenarioVersion, activateScenario, branchScenario, duplicateScenario, continueFromScenarioRevision, applyHistoricalOptimization, project CRUD/import/export
owners.lifecycle: IndexedDB workspace hydration and saves; durable Project/Scenario/Version lineage
owners.rationale: This hook already owns the actual repository boundary; a second pass-through workspace controller is rejected. App continues to own guard, restore and navigation transactions.

owners.type: shared Run record and successful current-result association lifecycle
state: latest optimization Run ref used for selected-solution metadata
owners.source: useRunHistory, domain/runCapture.js and domain/run.js plus current Project/Scenario/settings snapshot
owners.mutationApi: beginRun, finishRun, persistRun, selectParetoSolution, clearCurrentResult, clearRunHistoryWarning
owners.lifecycle: queued → running → succeeded/failed/cancelled; successful ordinary simulation/optimization Run becomes the current result association; cancelled/failed work does not replace it; historical rerun persists a new Run without replacing the current association
owners.rationale: Simulation and optimization share durable Run capture/persistence but keep distinct result payloads and capture functions. API request building and RF result mutations stay with their semantic workflows.

owners.type: report definition and artifact workflow coordination
state: derived report definitions and current-report-compatible Run selection
owners.source: current report input snapshot, useProjectWorkspace.saveReportDefinition, useRunHistory and useReportArtifacts
owners.mutationApi: exportCurrentMarkdown, exportCurrentHtml, generateHistoricalReport, regenerateArtifact, downloadArtifact, deleteArtifact, createPlanningReport
owners.lifecycle: on action dynamically load report implementation, create source-bound definition, generate bytes, attempt local retention, then expose download/open behavior; selectedArtifactId remains App navigation state; historical Run source stays explicit
owners.rationale: Implemented as a cohesive workflow coordinator. It uses existing pure report and artifact repository boundaries and does not eagerly import heavy report code.

owners.type: in-flight request cancellation and latest-request identity
state: AbortController instances and sequence IDs held in refs
owners.source: request begin/cancel calls from App workflows
owners.lifecycle: per request channel; aborts superseded requests and all in-flight work on unmount
owners.rationale: Keep runtime request refs out of durable state; App chooses existing cancellation channels.

owners.owner: LazyFeatureBoundary and owning lazy feature components (existing)
owners.type: feature activation/loading/error and feature-local transient state
state: feature load status/error; local research inputs and panel-only selections
owners.source: dynamic import on user activation and local React component state
owners.lifecycle: first open loads; collapse/reopen preserves mounted feature state; failed feature load is isolated
owners.rationale: Do not introduce a new controller import that statically pulls specialized 7I modules into the cold graph.

rejectedBoundaries.name: useWorkspaceController pass-through wrapper
rejectedBoundaries.reason: useProjectWorkspace already owns repository state and domain operations. Wrapping it without owning hydration/transition semantics adds indirection but no lifecycle ownership.

rejectedBoundaries.name: useMapWorkspaceState
rejectedBoundaries.reason: Some map fields are persisted plan inputs; selection and result association participate in RF invalidation, map inspection, Scenario snapshots and cross-feature navigation. A presentation-only controller would split a real shared lifecycle.

rejectedBoundaries.name: global store / context / state library
rejectedBoundaries.reason: No demonstrated correctness problem requires it; explicit App composition and focused hooks are sufficient.

rejectedBoundaries.name: generic executeAnything operation
rejectedBoundaries.reason: Simulation, optimization, network evaluation and historical replay have intentionally different request, result and lineage semantics. Share Run-record primitives only.

rejectedBoundaries.name: separate useResultController and useMapWorkspaceState hooks
rejectedBoundaries.reason: Result freshness and invalidation currently span App-level RF output, map overlays, plan edits, Scenario/Version transitions and navigation. A new hook would either pass through App setters or split Concept 7G source identity from rendered state without a cohesive independent lifecycle.

invalidationContract: App invalidatePlanResults remains authoritative: cancel dependent requests, clear rendered result artifacts, mark the plan dirty, and preserve currentResultRun as the historical source identity until an explicit workspace transition clears it.
